### TCP-in-TCP problems (3)
* outer TCP connection adds extra buffering 
   * more than UDP, because will usually buffer instead of dropping
 
<hr class="vspace" />
*  very high round-trip time if not careful
* can result in very poor TCP performance for nested connection
